title: size_bytes silently clamped to 0 on negative DB value (3 sites)
description: kith-store/src/lib.rs:434, message.rs:135, attachment.rs:108 — all three use .max(0) as u64 when reading size_bytes (i64) from the DB. A negative value indicates DB corruption or a write-path bug; silently clamping to 0 hides the error. The caller receives a size of 0 for an attachment that has real bytes, which will cause downstream mismatches (fetch will disagree with claimed size). Should return Err(KithError::Store(...)) instead of clamping.
